findings.fact: decodeSwapJournal ignores unknown keys and accepts backup_name '{final_name}.' + '*.rollback' without requiring a ULID infix. The writer always emits eight fields and '{final_name}.{ulid}.rollback'.
findings.invariant: On-disk journals from current save() are a subset of what decode accepts.

findings.fact: rewrite advances connected_at on every successful state write, so the column means state-last-written-at after the first refresh.
findings.invariant: Enrollment, sync, and re-auth all mint a new connected_at via nextConnectedAt.

findings.fact: List connect status --json always uses envelope status ok. Host-visible state enrolled|disconnected|needs attention lives in data.connections[].state. Envelope status degraded is used by connect status --source resume-revocation, not by the swap journal.
findings.invariant: CLI envelope status and connection_runs.status are distinct enumerations.

findings.fact: CAS UPDATE does not write consent_required. First INSERT sets consent_required=1.
findings.invariant: State swaps do not grant or revoke source consent.
